myprofile.title: My profile & services
myprofile.lead: What the clinic website shows about you, and the services you offer.
myprofile.photo_hint: Change your photo from “My account”; it shows on the website right away.
myprofile.manager_note: Your name, fee and working hours are set by the clinic manager.
myprofile.services_sub: The services you offer: shown when booking with you and on your page on the website. Leave the length empty for a service with no fixed time.
